note: In Temple-times, this was traditionally the last day holiday sacrifices could be brought after Shavuot (Feast of Weeks). This was according to Deuteronomy 16:16, “Three times in a year all your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which He chooses… and they shall not appear before the LORD empty-handed.”
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
